verdict.rationale: Rippling documents paying international contractors in local currency without waiting on bank transfers, in a unified global system with automated tax filing, which directly supports the story (rippling-docs-16, 17, 39, 40). However, there is no explicit evidence about compliant contractor agreement/contract generation, misclassification protection, or EOR-backed contracts, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the currency-payment claims. Missing for 10: documentation of compliant contract templates/misclassification safeguards, independent verification of local-currency payment execution, and country-coverage specifics.
